request: Analyze GSE269020 for PMID 40169574 (Exercise-induced anti-obesity effects in male mice generated by a FOXO1-KLF10 reinforcing loop promoting adipose lipolysis.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NovaSeq 6000, PE150, Hisat2 -> featureCounts; Novogene)
final.sample_inclusion: HFD-fed male WT (KLF10 flox/flox control) and KLF10 adipocyte-specific knockout (KLF10^AKO) mice, sedentary (no exercise); n = 4 per group
final.primary_estimand: Effect of adipocyte KLF10 knockout on the iWAT transcriptome of HFD-fed sedentary male mice (genetic estimand, not an exercise effect)
planned_contrasts: KLF10AKO vs WT in HFD-fed mice without exercise (Fig. 5a legend; paper: 2907 up, 1639 down = 4546 DEGs)
final.exercise_contrast_in_rnaseq: none: exercise (treadmill Ex vs Sed) appears only in physiology, RT-qPCR and western blot experiments (Fig. 4, Fig. 5d-g), not in the sequenced samples
final.paper_method: edgeR, Benjamini-Hochberg (S4.18.p1); Fig. 5 legend says two-sided Wald tests plus BH

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S4.18.p1: total RNA from iWAT of WT control and KLF10^AKO mice fed HFD; edgeR, BH, padj <= 0.05 and |log2FC| >= 1. FIG5 legend (a): 2907 up / 1639 down KLF10^AKO vs WT in iWAT of HFD-fed mice without exercise, n = 4 per group. DA.p1: GSE269020 holds the RNA-seq of Fig. 5a-c and Supplementary Fig. 5a,b. The exercise arms (Ex/Sed, Fig. 4) were never sequenced.

checks: DA.p1 names GSE269020 for Fig. 5a-c RNA-seq
GEO: iWAT, male, HFD-fed, genotype Wildtype/KLF10AKO, 4+4 samples, matches n = 4 per group in FIG5
contact institute Shanghai University of Sport, author Zhu J. as in DA.p1

ownership.reasoning: Accession, tissue, sex, diet, genotype levels and n per group all match the paper's RNA-seq description.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns WT_1..KO_4; metadata titles WT-1..KO-4. key derived from title (groups joined with _) gives an exact match. grp from title; agrees with characteristics genotype (Wildtype/KLF10AKO).

final.paper_input: read counts into edgeR (S4.18.p1); raw counts not deposited

matrix.reasoning: File name says FPKM; data_processing: featureCounts counts then FPKM calculated; 57% of values are integers only because many are 0; max 76877 non-integer. Not counts, so edgeR on counts cannot be reproduced. Recorded for completeness; the case stops at design.

final.available_contrast: grp KO vs WT (genetic, sedentary HFD only)

design.reasoning: The request is how exercise affects gene expression. All 8 sequenced samples are sedentary HFD-fed mice differing only in genotype (GEO characteristics: treatment HFD-fed constant; genotype Wildtype/KLF10AKO; FIG5 legend: 'without exercise'). There is no exercise or training arm, so no exercise estimand can be identified. Running KO vs WT would answer a genetic question, not the requested exercise question; it is not manufactured as a substitute.

candidates.value: grp KO vs WT as exercise proxy
candidates.reason_rejected: genotype contrast in sedentary mice; not an exercise effect

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast in the sequenced samples: GSE269020 contains only sedentary HFD-fed WT and KLF10^AKO iWAT (4 vs 4). The exercise (Ex vs Sed) groups of the paper were assayed by qPCR/western blot only.

discrepancies.disposition: would block paper route; moot because case is refused at design

discrepancies.data: FIG5 legend states Padj < 0.05 only for the 2907/1639 counts
